job.title: Sr. Software Engineer, AI Platform & Infrastructure
job.pay_full: $165,000 – $226,600 a year base salary (San Francisco Bay Area), plus equity (where applicable), bonus and benefits

details.about: Okta builds identity infrastructure that helps organisations adopt AI securely. The team that built Jeeva AI is now building Digital Workers, a new suite of autonomous agents for identity operations and security inside Okta, working directly with Okta's co-founder and CEO Todd McKinnon, with the chance to bring the product to Okta's 20,000+ customers. This engineer builds the backend and AWS platform that keeps these workers running around the clock: services, connectors, workflow execution, data and production reliability, mostly in Python and infrastructure code.
duties: Build Python FastAPI services, data models and reusable connectors for Okta, AWS, ServiceNow and enterprise applications
Implement durable execution with Step Functions, SQS and EventBridge, handling approval waits, rate limits, duplicate events and safe retries
Manage PostgreSQL schemas, indexes, query performance and pgvector retrieval, and enforce tenant isolation across APIs, storage and credentials
Build model API access with credentials, quotas, timeouts and cost controls
Add an analytics pipeline for worker events, traces and outcomes, evaluating ClickHouse and comparable systems such as BigQuery
Create reliable usage records and reconciliation
Build deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability and safe release controls
Implement scoped write services, kill switches, audit retention and backup recovery, and test failures
needs: Experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems, with strong coding skills in Python or a comparable language
Hands-on AWS experience with APIs, queues, containers, networking, IAM and databases
Strong SQL and data modeling skills, and experience diagnosing database performance and asynchronous system failures
Experience with infrastructure as code, deployment automation, observability and production incident response
Sound judgment about customer data, tenant isolation, credentials and safe changes to external systems
nice: ClickHouse, BigQuery or comparable analytics systems, event ingestion and usage metering
Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development
Deploying agent frameworks (prior identity experience is optional)
details.benefits: Base salary $165,000 – $226,600 a year for candidates in the San Francisco Bay Area; actual pay depends on skills, qualifications, experience and location. Okta also offers equity (where applicable), bonus and benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, a 401(k), a flexible spending account and paid leave (including PTO and parental leave).
notes: Stack: Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, containers, RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch, CloudTrail; React and AWS Amplify on the frontend
New hires start with an in-person onboarding experience
